question: As of February 2022, __________ is the youngest Flex Award winner in the field of Indian classical music instrument Pakhawaj and has joined the Ali Akbar College of Music for his research in Pakhawaj under the guidance of Padma Shri Pandit Swapan Chaudhuri.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Nishant Singh **
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Nishant Singh is the youngest Flex Award winner in the field of Indian classical music instrument Pakhawaj and has joined the Ali Akbar College of Music for his research in Pakhawaj under the guidance of Padma Shri Pandit Swapan Chaudhuri. **
 
• **The Fulbright Fellowship Program was founded by the United States Senator.**
 
• Nishant Singh will explore how historic Pankhawaj led to tabla wherein the former lost its rare compositions to the latter and aims to retrieve the forgotten compositions of the pakhawaj of Bengal style from the tabla of the Lucknow Gharana to popularize pakhawaj worldwide for generations to come.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​**Arijit Banerjee **from Siliguri to be blessed and motivated by stalwarts of classical music as he shares the stage with the likes of Pundit Malhar Ghosh, Pundit Digambar Mitra, Pundit Arup Chattopadhyay and Pundit Sujay Basu.
 
• **Sukhad Munde** is the son of one of India’s greatest pakhawaj players, the most ancient drum of North Indian Classical Music. He learned to speak the pakhawaj language at the same time a child learns to speak, and hence plays with the ease that one speaks one’s mother tongue. 
 
• **Rishi Shankar Upadhyay** is **a unique constellation of music, born in India and spreading his fame as a young Pakhawaj maestro**. He has been blessed with the art of music from his ancestors.
